## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 2 авг. 2026 г. - 19 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Cesar Augusto Alanoca Lima (tictac)_, 18 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Completely unusable — Blocked after just 2 days and 26 MB of use Review: ​I paid for an annual Starter plan and the app became completely useless within 48 hours. After using just 26 MB of data, saving basic links and a few images triggered a hidden attachment cap. Now I'm permanently stuck on a "limit reached" lock screen and cannot create, write, or edit notes unless I upgrade again. Paying for a full year to have an unusable app at 26 MB is unacceptable. Completely misleading."
            2. _Richard Castro_, 17 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible money grabbing app . Absolutely unusable unless you pay for it. Skip this app completely!"
            3. _Abhishek Chauhan_, 19 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "This was the best app for me since last 10 year. It pains me to give it 2 stars because the greed of the company has made this app unusable for free users. I was a paying user since last 4 or so years but I can't support greed of a corporation so I am stopping using this app now and moving all my notes to other app."
<!--/ir-theme-->
